text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'AUROC at 14 days of one cue with no fitting, oriented so that a higher score means a permanent change (below 0.50: the cue points the wrong way). Positives: one permanent kind. Negatives: all temporary moves. Dashed line: chance. Bars: 95% intervals, secondary.'
text.tspan: AUROC at 14 days of one cue with no fitting, oriented so that a higher score
means a permanent change (below 0.50: the cue points the wrong way).
Positives: one permanent kind. Negatives: all temporary moves.
Dashed line: chance. Bars: 95% intervals, secondary.
